description: This file contains an immutable implementation class 'ModifyFeatureDefinitionLiveCommandImpl' for the 'ModifyFeatureDefinitionLiveCommand' interface. It handles modifications of feature definitions in a live command context within the Eclipse Ditto framework, encapsulating command details like feature ID and feature properties, and providing methods to set headers and generate responses.

classes.name: ModifyFeatureDefinitionLiveCommandImpl
classes.description: An immutable class implementing the 'ModifyFeatureDefinitionLiveCommand' interface, encapsulating the command to modify feature definitions in a live context.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an instance of 'ModifyFeatureDefinitionLiveCommandImpl' from a generic 'Command' object, casting it to 'ModifyFeatureDefinition'.

methods.name: getFeatureId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the feature to be modified.

methods.name: getDefinition
methods.description: Returns the new feature definition details.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified Ditto headers set.

methods.name: changesAuthorization
methods.description: Indicates whether the command changes authorization, returns false.

methods.name: answer
methods.description: Provides a builder for creating a command answer.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the object.
